अपे अपे (अप-इ), cl. 2. P., cl. 1. A. अपैति,
अपायते. अपैतुम्, to go away, withdraw, retire, run
away, escape, vanish; to be wanting, to be omitted;
to start.

अपेत, अस्, आ, अम्, escaped, departed, gone; having
retired from, free from (with abl. or as last mamber
of a comp.).
—अपेत-भी, ईस्, ईस्, इ, one whose fear
is gone.
—अपेत-राक्षसी, f., N. of a plant, Ocimum
Sanctum.
अपेय, अस्, आ, अम्, removed (?).

अपेय अ-पेय, अस्, आ, अम्, unfit for drinking,
undrinkable.
अपेहि. See s. v. next col.

अपेहि अपेहि (imperative of rt. इ with अप),
at the beginning of several compounds, means exclud-
ing, expelling, denying admission; e. g. अपेहि-प्र-
कसा, f. a. ceremony where people are not admitted.
—अपेहि-बाणिजा, f. a. ceremony from which merchants
are excluded.
—अपेहि-वाता, f., N. of a plant useful
in expelling wind (Pœderia).

अपेक्ष् अपेक्ष् (अप-ईक्ष्), cl. I. A. अपे-
क्षते, -षितुम्, to look away, to look round, to
look about for something; to have some design; to
have regard to, to respect; to look for, wait for,
[]
except, hope; to require, to have an eye to; with
न, not to like.

अपेक्षण, अम्, n. or अपेक्षा, f. looking round
or about; (with the object either in loc. or as the
preceding member of a compound) consideration,
reference, regard; connection of cause with effect or
of individual with species; expectation, hope, desire,
need, requirement.
—अपेक्षया, with reference to.
—अपेक्षा-बुद्धि, इस्, f. a mental process in the
vaiśeṣika philosophy, the faculty of arranging and
methodising; clearness of understanding.

अपेक्षणीय or अपेक्षितव्य or अपेक्ष्य, अस्,
आ, अम्, to be considered or regarded, to be looked for
or expected, to be wished, desired, or required; desirable.

अपेक्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, (with the object in gen. or as
the preceding member of a compound) considering,
respecting, regarding, looking to; looking for, expect-
ing, hoping, requiring.

अपेक्ष्य, ind. having considered, having regard
to, with regard or reference to.

अपेज् अपेज् (अप-एज्), cl. 1. A. अपेजते, -जितुम्,
to remove, drive away. (See
Gram. 784

अपेन्द्र अपेन्द्र (˚प-इन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, without
Indra.

अपेशल अ-पेशल, अस्, आ, अम्, not clever, in-
expert.

अपेशस् अ-पेशस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. formless,
shapeless.

अपेष् 1. अपेष् (अप-इष्), cl. 4. A. अपेष्यते,
षितुम्, to strive after, aspire to.

अपेष् 2. अपेष् (अप-ईष्), cl. 1. A. अपेषते,
षितुम्, to withdraw from, to retire.

आपेक्षिक आपेक्षिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अपेक्षा),
raising expectations.
